youtube_description:
The topic of AI has always been fascinating, and the recent projects and innovation by companies like Google and Deep mind makes it seemingly magical. But how does this great and wonderful technology work?


Note: the neural network that I talked about in this video is just a standard SLP (single layer perceptron) that I have massively oversimplified for the ease of understanding. So for you nerds screaming that I am missing the bias or an activation function that's the reason why I didn't include it.
